messages:
Oliver: Quick life update — two things 🎉: I just got promoted to Senior Engineer and my partner and I are expecting a baby (due late Aug). Wanted to share since you all are my people.
Maya: WHAT 😭🙌 huge congrats on BOTH!! when's the due date? name inspo? :heart_eyes:
Jordan: Double congrats!! This calls for a celebration. Potluck next Friday? or lunchtime cake? :tada::cake:
Sam: Amazing @Oliver!! We should do a quick RSVP thread. Also — massive kudos on the promotion, well deserved.
Lina: Love love love. @people-ops can you flag parental leave options? Also we should coordinate a shower/gift for parents-to-be.
People Ops Bot: Hi @Oliver — congrats! To start parental leave enrollment, submit the Parental Leave form: https://redwood/hr/leave and your manager will be notified. (Automated message)
Rae: Congrats congrats!! For the celebration poll: react with cake 🍰 = lunch cake, pizza 🍕 = pizza party, bagel 🥯 = breakfast potluck, or laptop 💻 = virtual card + gift card.
Jordan: I'll set a Doodle but quick poll here — react pls.
Maya: Cake + diapers? jk. actually serious: diaper raffle idea? 😅
Oliver: Love the diaper raffle idea. Also planning to take 12 weeks after the birth — will coordinate with my manager on coverage, but any help organizing the team calendar would be cool.
Sam: We'll cover you — put placeholder on the team board and we can shuffle oncalls. And for the gift: can we do a group gift (diaper subscription or stroller)? Thoughts?
Rae: Diaper subscription + one nice baby item (carrier?) sounds solid. I'm happy to collect.
Lina: I'll create a Google Sheet for gift ideas + budget. Also adding a poll for dates (next Fri vs following Tues).
Maya: Also — congrats again, Senior Oliver! proud of you. :raised_hands:
Jordan: Official banner in #all-hands? or keep this low-key? :smile:
